summary: Steele Creek Capital Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a deleveraging plan approved by its board, including disinterested directors, to manage volatility and consider full liquidation and dissolution. The adviser sold 164 broadly-syndicated loan investments (75.8% of portfolio fair value as of June 30, 2026) via a Bids Wanted in Competition auction to over 22 dealers, generating gross proceeds of ~$73 million and a net loss of $1.7 million. Proceeds will repay ~$65 million outstanding under its Bank of America credit facility, which the company has elected to terminate. No advisers or deal terms specified.
